specification:
GEOMETRY ROOT — [ACTOR_1] is positioned immediately behind [ACTOR_2] in a close rear-aligned standing hinge. [ACTOR_2] bends forward through the hip joints with mild anterior pelvic tilt, a gentle inward lumbar line, and softly flexed knees; avoid a rounded upper/lower-back silhouette. Both actors retain their assigned body and furniture support contacts.

BASE SUPPORT GEOMETRY — USER-SUPPLIED DESIGN CONSTRAINTS, not image-observed: [ACTOR_2] keeps one leg raised while [ACTOR_1] supports that leg with one arm, producing an asymmetric standing hinge more demanding than USDG. The raised leg may surface-plant, remain suspended, or fold inward according to the variant. FRONT SUPPORT: One foot of [ACTOR_2] stays grounded on [FLOOR]; the opposite leg is lifted and externally supported by [ACTOR_1] at the knee, shin, calf, or ankle depending on the variation. A forward edge or armrest may provide additional front support when specified. REAR SUPPORT: Both feet of [ACTOR_1] stay on [FLOOR]; one forearm or hand supports the elevated leg of [ACTOR_2].

STRUCTURAL VARIATION — The user-specified baseline keeps one front leg rear-assisted and one foot grounded, with optional forward hand support.

V00 REAR ARM DEFAULT — One rear arm remains dedicated to supporting the lifted front leg; the other rear hand reaches forward to cup a front outer shoulder/upper arm with an inward-facing palm. Baseline rear-arm placement; no additional variation angle.

ARM AVAILABILITY — One rear arm remains on the elevated front leg at all times; only the free rear arm performs the named contact. No two-rear-hand chest wrap, face cup plus hip cup, or other impossible simultaneous contact is assigned.

INHERITANCE AND SUPPORT — Preserve the exact named leg/surface support topology and independent balance anchors from the base. Parent: UADG-FASS-V00. No paired inheritance change.

SOURCE BOUNDARY — User-designed text geometry, no source photograph or demonstrated physical pose; geometry and model fidelity remain untested.
